ctgov.note: All 4 ADMA-sponsored trials in ctgov are completed/terminated (legacy ASCENIV/RI-002, BIVIGAM, Civacir programs)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ADMA is a commercial-stage IVIG/plasma-derived biologics company. Per its 2025 10-K, all three approved products (ASCENIV, BIVIGAM, Nabi-HB) are commercialized. The single forward-looking R&D candidate, SG-001 (S. pneumoniae hyperimmune globulin), is in preclinical animal studies with a pre-IND package planned for FY2026. No active P1/P2/P3 clinical trial is enrolling. Label-expansion sBLA for ASCENIV pediatric is regulatory (post-marketing), not a new clinical trial.

commercial_product.ASCENIV: Immune Globulin Intravenous (Human) slra 10% - approved for PIDD adults/adolescents (FDA Apr 2019); pediatric sBLA filed Jun 2025, anticipated approval H1 FY2026
commercial_product.BIVIGAM: IVIG 10% - approved for PI in adults and pediatric patients >=2 years (FDA May 2019; pediatric expansion Dec 2023)
commercial_product.Nabi-HB: Hepatitis B Immune Globulin (Human) - approved for acute HBV exposure

excluded_preclinical: SG-001 - S. pneumoniae hyperimmune globulin; pilot-scale batch produced 2024; animal studies ongoing; pre-IND planned FY2026 (CNPV submitted Sep 2025); company anticipates progressing directly into registrational trial post-IND. Currently preclinical/IND-pending so excluded from active P1/P2/P3 list per workflow rule.
excluded_legacy_terminated: Civacir (HCV immune globulin) - NCT00473824 P2 terminated
NABI-IGIV 10% / RI-002 / RI-001 pivotal trials all completed (BLA approved as ASCENIV)

summary_counts.note: Commercial-stage company; no active clinical trials. SG-001 in preclinical/IND-prep (excluded). Three FDA-approved IVIG/hyperimmune products generating revenue.
